violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: casters on cooking equipment, area under the grill, and fan covers in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: The shared oil/grease disposal container has a build up of debris as well as the area around the container.
violations.corrective_action: Soiled receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent them from developing a buildup of soil or becoming attractants for insects and rodents.
